name: Haus Lechner
beschreibung: The Haus Lechner welcomes guests to the idyllic hamlet of Landl within the municipality of Thiersee in Kufsteinerland. This family-run alpine inn features tastefully appointed guest rooms with private shower/WC and partial balconies taking in the wooded hills of the Brandenberg Alps. In the rustic parlour, hearty Tyrolean culinary classics and refreshing beverages are served in a friendly atmosphere. The picturesque valley surrounding Lake Thiersee offers year-round recreation, ranging from summer hiking, cycling, and lakeside swimming to winter tobogganing, snowshoeing, and skiing. Genuine Tyrolean hospitality ensures a wonderfully relaxing escape.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional Tyrolean inn in Landl near Thiersee in Kufsteinerland offering comfortable rooms and authentic local cuisine.
